description: This bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," visually compares the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it (represented by blue bars) and an unnamed orange model (likely the RLHF-trained variant referenced in the paper), across nine distinct academic and practical benchmark datasets. The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," lists these benchmarks in left-to-right order: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled "Score (%)," represents performance as a percentage, scaled linearly from 0 to 80, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 10. For each dataset, two bars are grouped side-by-side: the blue bar corresponds to LLaMA-3-8B-it, and the orange bar corresponds to the other model. The chart shows that the orange model generally outperforms the blue model across most benchmarks, with the most notable exception being GSM-8K, where the blue bar reaches approximately 80% while the orange bar is slightly higher at approximately 81%. The orange model achieves scores ranging from approximately 30% on Chat-Arena-Hard to approximately 81% on GSM-8K, while the blue model scores between approximately 20% on Chat-Arena-Hard and approximately 80% on GSM-8K. The bars are presented in the order of the datasets as listed, without any specific sorting (e.g., descending by score), and there are no visual emphases such as shading, bolding, or annotations on any individual bars.
